verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I wanna be found faithful
I wanna be found steady
I wanna be found faithful
Until the end

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
I wanna live before Your eyes
I wanna stay before Your gaze
Just keep me steady
For all my days

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I wanna run the race
I wanna keep the faith
Help me win the prize
Of the knowledge of You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Don't wanna be ashamed
The day I see Your face
Keep my footsteps firm
Hold me in Your grace

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
When I stand before Your face, Lord I want to hear You say,
Well done, my good and faithful servant

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Revive me, Revive me
Not for me but for Your name
In Your mercy, deliver me
From my enemies

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
When the nations crumble (The word of the Lord will stay)
Kings may rise and fall (His love will endure)
Though the strong may stumble
The joy of the Lord is strength
To my soul

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I will declare my joys to the nation
Hey I will shout for joy to the congregation
I will worship God, worship God
All my days
Those who love the Lord are satisfied
Those who trust in him are justified
I will serve my God, serve my God
All my days

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I will not be shaken
I will not be moved
I will not be shaken
